shared._thumbnail_id: An album's cover, set as the post's and the track's featured image, which is where WordPress keeps one.
shared._wp_attachment_image_alt: A cover's alternative text, set on import where WordPress keeps it.

keep.riff_likes: What a listener liked. Theirs, and cumbersome to make again after a reinstall; Tools > Erase Personal Data deletes one listener's.
keep.riff_history: What a listener played recently, kept for the same reason as their likes.

cron.riff_catalog_backfill: Files a library from before 4.16.0 under its albums and artists, a batch at a time, as a big one takes longer than a request.
cron.riff_import_zip: Unpacks an uploaded album's zip after the upload's request, which it would outlast.
cron.riff_private_sweep: Protects a private site's audio and video when the setting changes, and every hour while it is private, for a file that arrived some way the upload's filter never saw.
cron.riff_protected_probe: Asks the web server, at most once a day, whether it sends the protected folder to anyone, so the Media Library and the notices never wait on a request.
cron.riff_protected_move: Moves protected files a batch at a time when the folder they are kept in changes (RIFF_PROTECTED_PATH), as a library takes longer to move than a request is given.

paths.RIFF_PROTECTED_PATH: Where a host keeps protected files outside the web root, so the web server never has them to send; Riff makes the site's folder inside it and moves files in and out. Riff refuses a path inside ABSPATH, wp-content, uploads, or the folder holding both WordPress and wp-content.
paths.riff_protected_path: The same folder, set by a plugin rather than wp-config.php, as a host's own plugin does for a network.
